tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dam tshig dang ldan pas rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom mo// de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhas+sarba dharmās+s+wa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa dhīḥdamar ser du bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng du pusti yod pa shin tu mdzes shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' mnabs par bsam/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas/ rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon pas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas pa bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang*/ g.yon brkyang pas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ gcer bu liṅga gyen du rgyas shing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ljags 'dril ba/

skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ dmigs nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drang*/ o ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ su ra ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas dbang gi chus lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ yang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas dbang gi lha rnams la rang la bstim/ rang gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ bsam nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad la mnyam par gzhag go /sngags zlo bar 'dod na thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas so// gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ gtor ma bshams la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/

zhes pas bsangs/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas gshin rje gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba bigh+nān mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i// zhe sdang gshin rje rdo rje ni// dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la// thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa// ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa// dud pa mun chen khyod la 'dud// ces pas bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ kha zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang yang ya mān+ta kar dmigs pa'i snying gar bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lto bar chos skyong srung ma dang*/ phyogs skyong bas gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad yod par bsams nas/ de rnams mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod/ spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang dang snang ba thams cad lha/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems pa dang cho 'phrul thams cad ting nge 'dzin du bsams la/ sdang ba dang zhen pa med par spyad do// nyal ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe lha'i skur ldang ngo*// de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na gnas skabs su bar du gcod pa zhi zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgyal bu a rog che zhes bya bas bskul nas/

'phags pas shing pho khyi'i lo zla ba bcu pa lhag pa'i tshes bco lnga la gnya' gong du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag nyi shu'i bsnyen pa bya// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
